_comment: Example project-local overlay, merged ON TOP of the shared tools/voice-rules.json by voice-gate.py --local-rules. The overlay only ADDS rules; it cannot remove a shared one. Copy this file to config/voice-rules.local.json in your real project and replace the example entries below with your own. The overlay is a good place for two kinds of rule: (1) style preferences specific to your project, and (2) hard 'never publish this' guardrails — e.g. a real client name, an NDA'd project codename, anything you must never let a generated draft surface. The example guardrail below is fictional; swap it for your actual guardrail list, and keep that file itself out of any copy of this repo you ever make public or hand to someone else.

regex.note: EXAMPLE ONLY: a do-not-publish guardrail for a confidential engagement codename. Replace with your own; delete if you don't need one.

words.note: EXAMPLE: prefer 'use' — a stand-in for whatever house-style word swap your own voice profile turns up.
